text.text_excerpt: I ordered a birthday cake for my fiancé from here. I ordered online and confirmed over the phone. The lady that I had contact with was friendly and professional. It was a surprise cake for my fiancé, but he was the one who picked it up. They wrapped it up so he did not see it when he brought it home, and were very helpful in keeping it a surprise. The cake was exactly what I ordered- it was beautiful, and tasted amazing. Although it wasn't cheap, it was worth what I paid. I would recommend Pure Cake for sure!

This review is extremely late and long overdue but I figured better late than never. My husband and I used Pure for our wedding in December of 2013. Hands down (and I'm not just saying this because it's my wedding), but the best wedding cake I've ever had. Several of my guests had the same reactions as well. The girls over at Pure were able to come up with a design that fit perfectly with what we wanted. Monique made the whole process extremely easy and was very personable with us. We even were able to get additional sheet cakes made so we were able to have some after the wedding and reception were over. My cake was vanilla with a salted caramel filling and my husbands cake was chocolate ...

Pure Cake did my wedding cake. After doing tastings at all "best of knot" bakeries...yes around 5 or 6... I was starting to get discouraged. Pure cake was my last scheduled tasting and it was so good! (I would have gone with another bakery on the Northshore if I hadn't found anything, but I really wanted to stay more local.) I'm so glad I did. The cake was beautiful and was SO good - especially since it was a wedding cake. Would recommend them to anyone.
